thread:
sasha: Hey finance — Brightline Health says their Q1 promo credit didn't apply, they were billed full usage on INV-2026-0042. Can someone check?
omar: I see the invoice, looks like promo tag `Q1-PROMO-15` wasn't attached to their account until after the billing snapshot (2026-02-28). :grimacing:
ash: ah that explains it. Do we usually apply retro credits for promo timing issues?
omar: We can do a manual goodwill credit for the delta. Need approval from finance lead for anything > $250.
elaine: I can approve up to $1k for first-touch ops misses. What's the requested amount?
sasha: Usage shows 1.2M tokens at $0.0008 => $960 billed. Promo should have been 15% = $144. They also got an onboarding promo of $100 which wasn't stacked. Net customer-facing credit request = $244. Details: invoice INV-2026-0042, cust_id BRIGHT-92.
ash: sounds reasonable. @elaine please confirm and I'll queue the adjustment.
elaine: Approved :white_check_mark: — please label as "goodwill: promo misapply" and note in ledger.
omar: Will create manual credit in Billing UI and post the refund transaction. Command I run:
```
# create manual credit
billingctl credit --customer BRIGHT-92 --invoice INV-2026-0042 --amount 244.00 --currency USD --reason "goodwill: promo misapply"
```
omar: tagging @ashwin for customer comms so we can explain and confirm balance update.
ash: I'll send the note to Brightline: short apology + confirmation of $244 credit, updated invoice attached.
stripe-bot: Refund/credit created: ID cr_1J2k9X2l, amount $244.00, status: pending.
omar: Posted ledger entry REF-2026-88 and set invoice as adjusted. Finance, please confirm when you reconcile this to the month.
elaine: Noted. I'll include in the Q1 manual adjustments sheet. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
ash: Customer replied already after my DM — appreciates the quick fix. Closing thread.
